features.feature: M0 documentation, vocabulary, and progressive hardening framing
features.source: M0 acceptance says docs must describe progressive hardening, milestone coverage, separate critics, and no replacement for REVIEW/TEST/DONE.

features.feature: M1 original_intent_snapshot_set/get with Intent MVP payload
features.covered_by: CHK-001 verificationIntent happy stores sourceText, normalizedOutcome, acceptanceClaim and reads it back
features.source: M1 plus Original Intent Snapshot MVP schema.

features.feature: M1 milestone_ledger_set/add/get with optional milestone intent triggering
features.covered_by: CHK-001 milestone_ledger_set/add/get; CHK-001 edge says single-outcome stories do not require a ledger
features.source: M1 acceptance requires optional ledger for multi-deliverable scope and no keyword-only milestone trigger.

features.feature: M1 immutable source request hash and key requirement ids
features.source: M1 deliverables explicitly include immutable source request hash and key requirement ids, but CHK-001 only names sourceText, normalizedOutcome, and acceptanceClaim.

features.covered_by: CHK-003 intent_coverage_check --dryRun reports uncovered milestones and missing acceptance bindings
features.source: M1 deliverables require checklist-to-ledger reference diagnostics.

features.feature: M2 dry-run intent coverage and ProofStory gate diagnostics
features.source: M2 deliverables include proofstory_gate_check --dryRun and intent_coverage_check --dryRun.

features.feature: M2 proofstory contract read surface and minimal diagnostic envelope storage
features.covered_by: CHK-002 proofstory_contract_set/get scoped to MVP diagnostic envelope only
features.excluded_by: CHK-002 adversarial says no story_advance enforcement or full M4 gate integration
features.source: M2 names proofstory_contract_get; command-family text allows hardening level to be stored in proofstory_contract_set without a standalone hardening command.
M2 deliverables list intent_collision_get, but no checklist item plans or verifies that command.

features.feature: M2 diagnostic breadth for missing red evidence, missing spike evidence, and scope ambiguity
features.source: M2 deliverables require diagnostics for missing red evidence, missing spike evidence, and scope ambiguity; CHK-003 verifies milestone/collision/acceptance diagnostics but does not name these outputs.

features.feature: M3 intent collision mutation artifact and signed/hash-bound collision evidence
features.excluded_by: understanding facts exclude M3-M9; CHK-003 only reports missing collision requirements in dry-run diagnostics
features.source: M3 starts with intent_collision_set and signed/hash-bound intent-collision artifact.

features.feature: M4 full ProofStory Contract and Gate enforcement
features.excluded_by: CHK-002 limits proofstory_contract_set/get to MVP diagnostic envelope; CHK-004 says do not enable global enforce behavior
features.source: M4 includes acceptance_contract_set, acceptance_evidence_bind, non-dry-run gate checks, and PLAN to DEV gate integration.

features.feature: M5 scope shrinkage guard and DONE intent equivalence
features.excluded_by: understanding facts exclude DONE equivalence enforcement; CHK-005 adversarial says final table must not imply DONE enforcement

features.feature: M6/M7 red evidence and spike evidence command implementation or enforcement
features.excluded_by: understanding facts exclude red/spike behavior; CHK-004 adversarial forbids red/spike enforce behavior
features.source: M6 and M7 implement red_evidence_* and spike_* commands plus enforce-mode blocking.

features.feature: M8/M9 REVIEW completeness critic and risk-adaptive enforcement rollout
features.excluded_by: understanding facts exclude REVIEW completeness lane and global enforce mode; CHK-005 adversarial excludes M3-M9 completion claims
features.source: M8 and M9 cover completeness critic integration and warn/enforce rollout flags.

features.feature: Global lifecycle enforcement or story_advance blocking
features.excluded_by: CHK-003 says diagnostics do not enforce DEV admission; decision preMortem says do not wire proofstory_gate_check into machine.ts or story_advance gates
features.source: Migration strategy reserves enforce mode for later rollout.
